bridges.cohort_line: Prior-integrated values are per 100,000-account cohort; ×12 figures assume 12 identical cohorts [A], not a portfolio guarantee.
bridges.deff_statement: All pilot power and decision figures use DEFF 1.1 for assumed household clustering [A]; ICC unverified. DEFF 1.0 / 1.25 appear only as sensitivity.
bridges.evsi_line: EVSI $45–$531 per cohort at 7,872/arm is value of information under assumed priors; not funding proof.
bridges.feasibility_line: One 10,000-account list gives at most 5,000/arm (55.6% / 17.9%). 7,872/arm needs 15,744 core accounts; 158,000-account proxy.
bridges.grid_wording: 80,000/arm is the first qualifying grid point for v2 fully loaded contribution; not an exact minimum. Unadjusted: not established through 160,000.
bridges.target_bridge_slide13: WP1 E4 target: variable profit, startup excluded, DEFF 1.1. v2 80,000: fully loaded, startup included, 90% follow-up. Not comparable; no reduction claimed.
bridges.transport_line: The 2% deployment prior is an assumption; selected non-test control churn is 4.842493% (2.42×). Assumption, not measurement.
bridges.variable_profit_definition: Variable profit = gross contribution minus $1 per treated contact; the $5,000 startup is excluded ($0.3176 per enrollee at 7,872/arm).

se_gamma_hat_delta_full.formula: sqrt((binary_p1 * (1 - binary_p1) / binary_enrolled_per_arm) / binary_p0**2 + (binary_p1**2 / binary_p0**4) * (binary_p0 * (1 - binary_p0) / binary_enrolled_per_arm))

se_gamma_hat_difference_scaled.formula: sqrt(binary_p0 * (1 - binary_p0) / binary_enrolled_per_arm + binary_p1 * (1 - binary_p1) / binary_enrolled_per_arm) / binary_p0
se_gamma_hat_difference_scaled.note: SE(p0hat - p1hat) / p0, p0 fixed; matches the brief's ~6.8 pp

v2_followup_retention.note: effective / enrolled per arm in the v2 simulation = 1 - follow-up loss
